description: Works out when a council or housing association in England must acknowledge and answer a tenant’s complaint under the Housing Ombudsman’s Complaint Handling Code (2024): at stage 1, acknowledge within 5 working days and respond within 10 working days of acknowledging (paras 6.2 to 6.4); at stage 2, acknowledge within 5 and respond within 20 (paras 6.11 to 6.15), each with the longest extension. It counts working days, leaving out weekends and bank holidays in England and Wales; a complaint received at a weekend or on a bank holiday counts from the next working day. Give the dates the landlord acknowledged or answered, if it has, to see whether each was on time. It says when the Code does not usually apply (private landlords, Wales). It never says what a complaint will achieve.

acknowledgedOn.description: The day the landlord acknowledged it, if it has (YYYY-MM-DD).

asAt.description: Work it out as at this date instead of today in England (YYYY-MM-DD).

landlord.description: Who the landlord is: "council" or "housing_association" (in England), "private" (a private landlord or letting agent) or "wales" (any landlord in Wales).

receivedOn.description: The day the landlord received the complaint (stage 1) or the request for stage 2. Sent by email or an online form: the day it was sent (YYYY-MM-DD).

respondedOn.description: The day the landlord gave its response at this stage, if it has (YYYY-MM-DD).

stage.description: For a council or housing association: "1" for a complaint, or "2" when the tenant has asked for it to go to stage 2 after an unsatisfactory stage 1 answer.

name: calculate_landlord_complaint_deadlines
title: Landlord complaint deadline calculator
